visible_objects.description: The single softmax line from the manual attention path, shown large and centred, highlighted as the focus.

visible_objects.description: A tag attached to the code saying this code runs only when self.flash is false. It stays on screen for the whole video.

must_show_covered: The code line `att = F.softmax(att, dim=-1)` with a label saying it belongs to the `self.flash`-false (manual) branch

visible_objects.description: The masked_fill line, which runs just before softmax. It appears directly above the softmax line so the order reads top to bottom.
visible_objects.change: Enters above the softmax line, glows briefly, then dims as the grid appears.

visible_objects.description: The softmax line, now below the mask line and not yet active.

visible_objects.description: Branch tag, still attached to the code pair.
visible_objects.label: self.flash false: manual branch
visible_objects.change: Moves with the code to the top-left.

visible_objects.description: A small 4x4 square grid of scaled, masked scores. Each row is one query and each column is one key. The cells above the diagonal (future positions) read -inf and are clearly marked. The cells on and below the diagonal are shaded to show raw score values.
visible_objects.label: masked scores: -inf above diagonal
visible_objects.change: Builds in at centre stage. The -inf marks then stamp into the above-diagonal cells, coming from the mask line.

must_show_covered: A small square score grid with -inf in the cells above the diagonal (future positions)
beats.transition: The code recedes to the top-left as the score grid builds in at the centre.
beats.framing: Score grid centred and dominant. The code pair and branch tag stay small at the top-left.

visible_objects.description: The same 4x4 grid. One query row (a row with some -inf cells) is lifted out and highlighted. The other rows dim but stay in place.
visible_objects.label: masked scores: -inf above diagonal
visible_objects.change: The other rows dim while the chosen row lifts out and enlarges.

visible_objects.description: A bracket around the chosen query row, showing that softmax works across this row's keys (the last dimension).
visible_objects.label: one query row (dim=-1)
visible_objects.change: Appears around the lifted row.

visible_objects.description: Each cell of the chosen row turns into a vertical bar. The cells that had scores become non-negative bars of different heights. The -inf cells shrink to flat bars of height zero. The bars then resize together until they total 1.
visible_objects.label: weights
visible_objects.change: The raw score cells turn into bars. The -inf bars fade to zero and the rest settle to their final heights.

visible_objects.description: A marker under the former -inf positions showing they now have exactly zero weight.
visible_objects.label: -inf → 0 weight
visible_objects.change: Appears as the -inf bars flatten to zero.

visible_objects.description: A readout beside the bars that adds up the row's weights. It ticks while the bars resize and stops at 1.
visible_objects.label: sum = 1
visible_objects.change: Counts while the bars resize, then settles on 1.

visible_objects.description: The softmax line at the top-left, now active.
visible_objects.change: Lights up while the row is transformed.

visible_objects.description: Branch tag at the top-left.
visible_objects.label: self.flash false: manual branch
visible_objects.change: Stays in place, still visible.

beats.narration_line: Each row's scores become weights that add up to 1.

visible_objects.description: The full 4x4 grid again. Rows are turned into weights one at a time from top to bottom. Each row's -inf cells become zero, and finished rows stay as weights.
visible_objects.label: masked scores: -inf above diagonal
visible_objects.change: The converted row drops back into place. The remaining rows then light up and turn into weights one after another, never all at once.

visible_objects.description: The row bracket, which moves down the grid to whichever row is being normalized.
visible_objects.label: one query row (dim=-1)
visible_objects.change: Steps down one row at a time.

visible_objects.description: A sum readout that appears at the end of each row as that row finishes, each settling on 1.
visible_objects.label: sum = 1
visible_objects.change: A copy appears beside each row as it finishes.

visible_objects.description: Branch tag at the top-left.
visible_objects.label: self.flash false: manual branch
visible_objects.change: Stays in place, still visible.

visible_objects.description: The single-row bars from the previous beat.
visible_objects.label: weights
visible_objects.change: Fold back into the grid row as shaded weight cells, then exit as separate bars.

must_show_covered: The rest of the rows being normalized one row at a time (along dim=-1), not as one whole matrix

beats.on_screen_text: Softmax runs along dim=-1, one row at a time.

visible_objects.description: The finished 4x4 grid of weights. It is lower-triangular: cells above the diagonal are zero, and each row's weights add up to 1.
visible_objects.label: masked scores: -inf above diagonal

visible_objects.description: A small note with an arrow leading off the right edge of the grid, showing that this matrix goes next to dropout and then to att @ v.
visible_objects.label: Next: self.attn_dropout(att), then att @ v

visible_objects.description: Branch tag at the top-left.
visible_objects.label: self.flash false: manual branch

visible_objects.description: The per-row sum readouts.

visible_objects.change: Fade out as the note enters.
